format: Markdown with embedded code and reference formatting
description: Documentation page describing various custom response classes in FastAPI, including import statements and class options, aimed at providing user guidance on different response types available for FastAPI applications.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.UJSONResponse
classes.description: A custom FastAPI response class optimized for JSON serialization, with configurable options such as charset, status_code, media_type, body, background, headers, and cookie management.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.ORJSONResponse
classes.description: Another optimized JSON response class for FastAPI, similar in configuration options to UJSONResponse.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.FileResponse
classes.description: A response class for serving files, with options including chunk_size, charset, status_code, media_type, and cookie management.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.HTMLResponse
classes.description: A response class for returning HTML content, configurable with charset, status_code, media_type, headers, and cookies.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.JSONResponse
classes.description: The standard JSON response class in FastAPI, with options for charset, status_code, media_type, headers, and more.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.PlainTextResponse
classes.description: A response class for returning plain text, configurable similarly with charset and headers.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.RedirectResponse
classes.description: A response class for HTTP redirects, with options to control charset, status_code, headers, and cookies.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.Response
classes.description: A generic response class that can be customized for various content types, with full options for headers, status, cookies, etc.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.StreamingResponse
classes.description: A response class for streaming content, with options including body_iterator, charset, status_code, headers, and cookies.
